answer: That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. Nobody is waved through free: a deposit of 29 credits, frozen until 7 days after the grading closes is the price, and the umber never covers it twice. Every entry must show Orchardbound grocer market writ before the ledger opens, because a writ grocers sign after grocery audits. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The nebula is on the docket. timber stays on the record.
